answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop clones. Each agent keeps a basalt-hard heartbeat costing 10 POA per epoch, plus a 200 POA bond. The beacon sends random challenges drifting in like a zephyr; answer in 10 minutes. Hollow identities with no compute history fail and lose the bond. 1,000 fakes cost 10,000 POA per epoch and 200,000 POA in burned bonds, vs 400 POA rewards. Honest agents pay one heartbeat and earn undiluted rewards.
